A short, periodically updated snapshot. **Last updated: September 2026.**

## Research

I am working on methods and open data for safer, more accessible active travel, with collaborators at the University of Leeds and beyond.

## Open tools

- [SaferActive](https://saferactive.github.io): data-driven methods for cyclist and pedestrian safety.
- [Propensity to Cycle Tool](https://www.pct.bike): open-source modelling of cycling potential.
- [Transport Data Science](https://github.com/ITSLeeds/tds): teaching and reproducible research workflows.

## Collaboration

I welcome conversations about reproducible transport data science, open-source software, and evidence for sustainable transport. [Get in touch](/contact/).
